fields.Name: Predictive Studio Maintenance (not wired)
fields.Description: Not wired: no Action exists behind this job, so enabling it fails with "ActionID is required" and nothing runs. It is kept Disabled as a placeholder for the Predictive Studio maintenance pass (staleness, scheduled re-scoring, retraining with a challenger comparison), which is built in the engine but not connected to any job. Per-model monitoring jobs replace it in a later release; until then do not enable it.
